description: Create a new Search Engine Service cluster (G2). Use dryRun=true to preview.

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, '-'; starts with a letter, ends with a letter or number, no consecutive '-')

dataNodeStorageSize.description: Data node storage size in GB (100-2000, 10GB increment, SSD)

dryRun.description: If true, preview only without creating

isMasterOnlyNodeActivated.description: Enable dedicated master nodes. If true, the three masterNode* parameters below are required

loginKeyName.description: Authentication key name for SSH access

masterNodeCount.description: Number of master nodes (3 or 5, default: 3). Required when isMasterOnlyNodeActivated=true

masterNodeProductCode.description: Master node server type code. Required when isMasterOnlyNodeActivated=true

masterNodeSubnetNo.description: Master node subnet number. Required when isMasterOnlyNodeActivated=true

searchEngineUserName.description: Admin account ID (3-15 chars, same rule as clusterName)

searchEngineUserPassword.description: Admin password: 8-20 chars mixing letters, numbers and special characters; must not contain ' " ` ₩ / & or spaces

name: ncloud_ses_create_cluster
